bodyDesign: 举笛→吹奏释放→落手；声波独立

actualReferenceOverride.prop: yellow bull flutist, black topknot/black horns, purple hands and muzzle, cool pale silver-blue gray robe with dark blue-gray long vertical strips, tiny muted gold motifs, black ankle boots; LONG pale ivory bamboo transverse flute always held horizontally across mouth with BOTH hands. Preserve flute length and cool robe colors, NOT warm cream/brown robe.
actualReferenceOverride.attack: Keep both hands on SAME full-length pale flute, play one short phrase with tiny torso lean. Show the whole flute horizontally across the mouth. No flash or weapon.
actualReferenceOverride.skill: Both hands continue holding same horizontal flute at mouth, small composed forward lean, no second flute, no removal, no warm color change.
